name: Iinari
source:
Main character begins experimenting with Mizuki who he met on a sex friend search website. To what extent a pure innocent girl can be corrupted?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在寻找性伴侣的网站上认识了瑞树兰，并开始以她为对象进行实验：一个纯洁无瑕的女孩，究竟能够堕落到什么程度？
